Vintage South Tyneside memories as we reflect on the Antiques Roadshow's visit to Souter

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:26
Instaread
By Chris Cordner

Digital specialist in nostalgia

Published 30th Sep 2026, 16:00 BST

Memories from Boldon, Cleadon and South Shields spanning from 1968 to 2018

Treasures galore were on show when the Antiques Roadshow came to South Tyneside.

The BBC’s Antiques Roadshow visited Souter Lighthouse and saw presenter Fiona Bruce explore its history, as reported in the Shields Gazette.

The borough is no stranger to visits by antiques experts with Paul Laidlaw, Charles Hanson and Anita Manning all coming to the area in years gone by.

Have a look at memories from Boldon, Cleadon and South Shields spanning from 1968 to 2018.

Or perhaps you would like to tell us about other types of nostalgia you would want to see in our retro section.

It might be memories of your favourite shop, club, nightclub or restaurant. Maybe you want to get back in touch with former workmates from a South Tyneside factory, or with pals who you went to school with.

Or perhaps you would like to share memories of a sporting occasion in the past which you would like to revisit.

Tell us more by emailing chris.cordner@iconicmediagroup.co.uk
